pull.title: KAFKA-21295: Producer will account for overflow when splitting batches
pull.body:
`ProducerBatch.split()` assigns sequences to the split pieces with raw integer addition. [KAFKA-7693](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-7693) fixed an overflow bug in the normal send path, and I am replicating that fix here. 

So when a producer's per-partition sequence is near 2^31 and a batch straddling the wrap is rejected with `MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE` and split, one piece receives a negative base sequence.

This PR is my original work and I license the work to the project under the project's open source license.
